answer: Each identity must tend one orchard plot fed by a single river allotment auctioned fresh every epoch. Water cannot be stored or shared: unused allotments evaporate, and a plot that receives another plot's water fails its soil-tracer check. Only a velvet harvest, grown slowly on that plot alone, earns standing. Clones must each win an auction, tend a separate plot, and pass separate tracer checks, so fifty clones need fifty plots, fifty bids, and fifty seasons of care — and bidding against themselves drives the water price up faster than their count.
